{{Quote|My backup plan is to have Wran go down to ground level and just kill everybody. If he can clean a wide enough gap in the enemy lines before they get him, we can sneak out.''"<br />"''I heard that. Though I am at least that good.|Sharr Latt and Wran Narcassan|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Wran Narcassan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the son of [[Vula Nelprin]] and the nephew of [[Shalla Nelprin]], a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He adopted the Narcassan family name of his maternal grandfather, [[Vyn Narcassan]], because he considered his own [[Wran Narcassan's father|father]] an unsuitable role model.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> Wran was recruited by [[Sharr Latt]] into his newly reformed unit of Wraith Squadron as a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]]. Their unit was assigned by its leader, [[Garik Loran]], to investigate [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] and his involvement in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]]. Wran's unit later merged with [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s Wraith Squadron after the two groups encountered one another while infiltrating [[Glitterby Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] in search of evidence of Thaal's crimes.<ref name="MK" /> 

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Wran's a deep thinker. And even better with hands and feet than with that rifle.|Sharr Latt on Wran Narcassan|<ref name="MK" />}}
Wran was a capable hand-to-hand combatant, like his mother and aunt. He was also an accomplished sniper.<ref name="MK" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Wrann Narcassan was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
